name: Feature request
about: Suggest something the tool should do
title: ''
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

**What do you want to do?**
The job you are trying to get done, not the feature. Example: "see why the engine light came on without going to a dealer".

**What happens today?**
What you tried and where it stopped.

**Which car and adapter?**
Year / model / engine, and the adapter if it matters. A feature for one platform may not fit another.

**Notes**
This project's release only reads from the car. Requests to write to a car (clear codes, tests, resets) are welcome as ideas,
but read [Safety](https://github.com/huhwhatbruh/HondaDiagnosticSuite/wiki/Safety) first: that code has only run on simulators
and is not in the release. The [Roadmap](https://github.com/huhwhatbruh/HondaDiagnosticSuite/wiki/Roadmap) lists what is planned.
